scope: Contextual transport of all local Rex roots in the 17 audited lowering relation classes
repairs: Root walking includes Values, filters, join/ASOF conditions, aggregate direct arguments, window constants/bounds/calls, sort bounds and table-function calls.
WindowAggregate preserves exact subclass, ordinal, DISTINCT, IGNORE NULLS and parser position; even constant arguments do not make the aggregate independent of its scope.
Window input context appends the separate constant slots; multi-input relations use ordered concatenated fields.
Felderas ARRAY_AGG replacement resolves to its exact trusted singleton, distinct from Calcites ARRAY_AGG.
Strict corpus records carry an explicit optimized_projects or local_fields scope; mixed/unknown scopes are rejected.
limitations: The table transports each relations local expression roots separately. Cross-relation expression/binding identity and relation edges are not transported.
AggregateCall descriptors outside Window are relational metadata, not ordinary Rex roots; their operators, keys and ordering still need a relation adapter.
Window groups, frame semantics, collation, traits and hints are not certified by the local Rex capture.
Statement order, catalog effects, source submission boundaries and detached S1-to-S2 remain open.
Specialized RexOver/subquery/transient forms and collated constructor names remain unsupported.
The full corpus is compile-only; two focused runtime tests are certified separately in s1-function-bodies.json.
